name: RAC 互联网络诊断 — 私有网络延迟/带宽/丢包诊断
description: RAC 互联网络（Private Interconnect）是 Cache Fusion 的通信通道。互联网络的延迟、带宽和丢包直接影响 gc 等待事件的时长。本规则覆盖互联网络的性能诊断、常见问题识别和优化建议。

conditions.desc: gc cr block busy 平均等待 > 5ms

skip_when.desc: 单实例环境无互联网络
gc 等待 avg < 1ms 且无 lost 事件

root_causes.name: 互联网络带宽不足
root_causes.desc: 互联使用 1GbE 而高 redo/block transfer 场景需要 10GbE+。带宽饱和导致排队延迟。

root_causes.name: 互联网络有丢包
root_causes.desc: 网卡故障、交换机拥塞、线缆问题导致丢包。gc block lost 事件增多，3 次重试后 timeout。

root_causes.name: 互联使用了公共网络
root_causes.desc: 互联网络错误配置到公共网络接口，业务流量干扰 Cache Fusion。

root_causes.name: UDP 缓冲区不足
root_causes.desc: OS 层 UDP 接收/发送缓冲区过小，高吞吐时丢包。

root_causes.name: 交换机 Jumbo Frame 不匹配
root_causes.desc: 节点配置了 Jumbo Frame (MTU=9000) 但交换机未启用，导致分片和延迟。

step1_check_interconnect.sql: SELECT inst_id, name, ip_address, is_public FROM GV$CLUSTER_INTERCONNECTS ORDER BY inst_id

step2_check_gc_waits.desc: 检查 gc 等待统计
step2_check_gc_waits.sql: SELECT event, total_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/GREATEST(total_waits,1)/1000,2) avg_ms, ROUND(time_waited_micro/1e6) total_sec FROM v$system_event WHERE event LIKE 'gc%' AND total_waits > 100 ORDER BY time_waited_micro DESC FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY

step3_check_gc_transfer.desc: 检查 block transfer 统计
step3_check_gc_transfer.sql: SELECT inst_id, name, value FROM GV$SYSSTAT WHERE name IN ('gc cr blocks received','gc current blocks received','gc cr block receive time','gc current block receive time','gc blocks lost','gc blocks corrupt') ORDER BY inst_id, name

step4_check_ksxp.sql: SELECT inst_id, name, value FROM GV$SYSSTAT WHERE name LIKE 'ksxp%' AND value > 0 ORDER BY inst_id, value DESC

step5_os_network_check.sql:
-- ping -c 100 -i 0.01 <other_node_private_ip> | tail -3
-- ifconfig <private_nic> | grep -i 'errors\|dropped'
-- ethtool <private_nic> | grep Speed
-- cat /proc/sys/net/core/rmem_max
SELECT 'Run OS-level network diagnostics' AS action FROM dual
